purpose: A complete original Greek sanctuary landscape around the accepted playable 217 stone floor, using one shared native coordinate system.
reference_note: Read-only PrintWindow capture 2560x1600. Source capture and measured/occluded-inferred geometry remain authoring evidence, never a shipped Dofus background.
normalization: Reference geometry uniformly scaled by 0.75. The generated 1503x1047 landscape painting is mechanically resampled to 1920x1200 as a decorative surface only, clipped to the unchanged Land polygon. Foreground regions use uniform scales. Combat geometry never derives from raster pixels.
stone_contract: Original stone sprites, alpha and vertices retained; local limestone palette and flat front bevel. Interior joints use the Land meadow; exterior edges share compacted earth with the combat band.

legacy_sources.note: Earlier monolithic compositions retained as historical source assets after user rejection. They are not displayed by the current battle scene.

internal_dofus_technology: Unknown. The observed projection and contour were measured from screenshots. Layered Godot rendering, local shaders and the terrain composition architecture are our implementation choices.

validation.scope: 217 complete rendered floor polygons on rendered land; no rock-footing overlap; shared Land/stone texture instance and UV/tint/repeat; real GridView movement and guard cast. Native OS pointer input not certified.

art_completion.method: Original image_gen landscape painting clipped to the unchanged authored Land polygon; separate alpha foreground atlas; real stone combat sprites.

land_paint.normalization: Whole illustration resampled bicubically to native canvas. This normalizes artwork only; no grid vertex, camera, land or shore coordinate is derived from the painting.
land_paint.sampling: Native plane UVs; clamp; same Texture2D instance, UV scale and tint used by 217 stone meadow joins.
land_paint.rear_scenery: Olive grove, Greek ruined arch, columns and continuous broad limestone bluff are painted into Land; old two isolated back sprites removed.

foreground_atlas.handling: Exact generated PNG bytes, native alpha; two bottom regions sampled directly, no independent X/Y stretching.

art_completion.geometry_invariant: Land polygon, shorelines, canvas, exclusions, all floor and VOID cells, origin, axes, blocker/spawn data and foreground world anchors unchanged from the accepted registered terrain version.
art_completion.art_direction: Warm sunlit Greek sanctuary; continuous olive grove, limestone bluff, textured meadow, separate foreground vegetation and stones; quiet tactical center.

combat_ground_band.method: Geometry-derived outline and procedural soil shader; no new bitmap

production_promotion_validation.gut_scope: Current Catabase including room-II spectre integration
production_promotion_validation.gameplay_fix: Clear combat-effect deduplication at Unit.reset_combat_resources, regression red then green
limitations: QA victory is forced after real movement/guard; no complete combat or balance certification
